name: Mendo Breath
summary: **Mendo Breath** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Gage Green Genetics]], named for California's Mendocino County. A cross of [[ogkb|OGKB]] and [[mendo-montage|Mendo Montage]], it began as a clone-only cut before being released as feminized seed. It has since been used as a parent in numerous Gage Green crosses, including [[peanut-butter-breath|Peanut Butter Breath]].
